setting: a municipal observatory rooftop at dawn with analog astronomical and cartographic instruments

baseline_prompt_en: Create a cinematic documentary photograph of an unmistakably adult woman working as a survey astronomer on a municipal observatory rooftop at dawn. She steadies a transparent city-map overlay across a weathered atlas and draws an azimuth line from a brass transit telescope toward the bright morning star, while a mechanical chronometer, compass, penciled coordinate grid, and wind-lifted survey sheets make the cartographic task legible. Frame her chest-up, nearly frontal with only a restrained three-quarter turn and a calm neutral expression. Pin every strand away from both temples, cheekbones, jaw corners, and chin so the full bilateral facial outline is visible. Shape the contour widest high across the temples and upper cheekbones, then narrow it continuously through the lower cheeks into a compact softly rounded chin; keep the temple-to-cheek arcs smooth and the jaw corners gentle but readable. Use distortion-controlled portrait perspective and soft side-to-front dawn light that models the outline without deep shadow. The supplied image guides only broadly visible adult appearance; this specified facial geometry takes precedence over its silhouette.

interpretation_provenance.resolution: A seeded choice among independently authored, nonsexual adult scenes in the assigned dawn-rooftop analog astronomy and cartography domain, resolved here as a municipal celestial survey.
Use the supplied image as an appearance reference for broadly visible adult traits only, without making a biometric identity claim; the facial-outline test target remains controlling.
